hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" == *.go ]]; then PKG="$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH")/..."; OUTPUT="$(go vet "$PKG" 2>&1)"; STATUS=$?; if [[ -n "$OUTPUT" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$OUTPUT" | sed -n '1,5p'; fi; exit $STATUS; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" == */internal/* ]] && [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" == *.go ]]; then PKG=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" | sed 's|.*/internal/|./internal/|' | sed 's|/[^/]*$|/...|'); OUTPUT="$(go test "$PKG" -count=1 -timeout 30s 2>&1)"; STATUS=$?; if [[ -n "$OUTPUT" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$OUTPUT" | tail -3; fi; exit $STATUS; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'internal/repository/db/'; then echo 'BLOCK: This file is sqlc-generated. Edit db/queries/*.sql instead, then run make sqlc-generate.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE 'db/migrations/00[0-9]{4}.*\.(up|down)\.sql$'; then APPLIED=$(ls db/migrations/*.up.sql 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "WARNING: Editing an existing migration. If already applied to any environment, create a new migration instead." >&2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.env$|\.env\.local$'; then echo 'BLOCK: .env files may contain secrets. Use internal/config/config.go with environment variables instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAM_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'Dockerfile'; then echo 'NOTE: Dockerfile builds 3 binaries (api, worker, temporal-worker). Changes affect all services.' >&2; fi
